heading: Features that speak visually
subtext: Every feature gets an icon. Icons help users scan and recognize capabilities at a glance.

items.title: Modular architecture
items.description: Components are independent, composable, and easy to replace without side effects.

items.title: Theme-aware styling
items.description: Every component respects light and dark mode, brand colors, and typography tokens.

items.title: Config-first workflows
items.description: Build pages from JSON. Update copy, layout, and media without touching templates.

items.title: Performance built in
items.description: Zero client JS by default. Static-first, hydration-free, and Lighthouse-optimized.

items.title: Accessibility first
items.description: Semantic HTML, ARIA labels, keyboard navigation, and contrast-safe color tokens.

items.title: Open ecosystem
items.description: Import any Astro component, use any framework island, extend with your own blocks.
